notes.title: Updated to version 1.60
notes.notes:
This game has been updated to version 1.60.
Added "Level 9" and "STEAM Achievement".
You need a graphics board on your computer to play level 9.
You can play the previous version by right-clicking the game name from the STEAM application and clicking "Properties" "Beta".

notes.title: BugFix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that sometimes all enemies were annihilated with ScoreRankingStage.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.20
notes.notes:
Dear customers.
We updated the game to Version 1.20
Please check the following points.

We raised the mobility of F-104.
We lowered the mobility of F15Ace and YF22Ace.
Added the display of  "ENEMY LEFT".
Added STEAM-Achievement of the Extra stage.
Tripled the distance that player can see.

It is not a bug if the last your enemy start to escape the combat area.
We confirmed by test play that all levels can be completed.
"LEVEL 3 with ACE mark on STEAM-Achievement" is really difficult.
Flight Shooter Game beginners can play other stages instantly.

Thank you!
